verdict.rationale: Teams documents Outgoing Webhooks that send channel text messages to an external web service (ms-teams-docs-12), which is a narrow form of event delivery to your endpoint. Connectors and Incoming Webhooks (ms-teams-docs-30, ms-teams-docs-36, ms-teams-docs-44) carry data into Teams rather than delivering Teams events outward. A community report notes that integration requires the full Azure/Graph stack rather than simple webhooks (ms-teams-comm-11). Missing for 10: a general event-subscription mechanism covering events beyond channel messages, documented subscription setup/lifecycle and payload details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
